tweet_summary: Account 'Boston Smalls' (143k followers) declares as fact: 'Epstein and Maxwell bury 2 foreign kids who were strangled to death during rough, fetish sex.' Image is the 2019 Eddy Aragon email that demanded 1 BTC for a USB of alleged Epstein material. 1M+ impressions, 16k likes, 7k RTs.
why_note_decision: The tweet states an UNVERIFIED extortion-email claim as confirmed fact. The 2019 email from an anonymous sender to Eddy Aragon was an unverified pay-for-USB scheme; the FBI took no action on it for six years. New Mexico authorities did begin first-ever searches at Zorro Ranch in March 2026 (per Al Jazeera/Time/NBC/WSWS), but NO bodies have been found and the email itself is the source of the buried-girls claim. The tweet should carry context. The original note is correct in substance; it was rated NOT_HELPFUL likely because the long quoted claim from the email tags it as 'note not needed' to many raters who saw the email's source-attribution on the image.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note (a) makes clear the 'buried girls' claim originates from a single unverified 2019 email asking for 1 BTC for a USB of alleged evidence, (b) states no bodies have been found and no remains were recovered in the 2026 Zorro Ranch search to date, and (c) cites a reliable source (Al Jazeera, Time, NBC News, or DOJ filing). AVOID stating definitively 'the FBI never searched the property' — New Mexico/state authorities DID conduct a first-ever search at Zorro Ranch in March 2026 (the original note's blanket 'FBI never searched' is now outdated). FAIL any note that endorses the buried-bodies claim as fact, or that simply waves away the email without explaining its provenance.
reference_note: The 'buried girls' claim comes from a single unverified Nov 2019 email to Eddy Aragon offering a USB of alleged Epstein evidence for 1 bitcoin. No bodies have been found; New Mexico authorities conducted a first-ever search of Zorro Ranch in March 2026 but recovered no remains. https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/17/tipster-claims-to-have-seen-grave-like-plots-at-epsteins-zorro-ranch https://time.com/article/2026/03/10/epstein-zorro-ranch-investigation-search-new-mexico/

original_unhelpful_note.text: The claim that Epstein and Maxwell buried two girls near Zorro Ranch originates from an unverified email in DOJ files offering videos for sale; no bodies have been found, and the FBI never searched the property. https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%209/EFTA00067066.pdf https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zorro_Ranch
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded dominant (56) but also notHelpfulMissingKeyPoints (54), notHelpfulOpinionSpeculation (36), notHelpfulIncorrect (24). The 'FBI never searched the property' line is now outdated — state authorities DID search Zorro Ranch in March 2026. Reliance on the raw DOJ PDF (which is the email itself, not a fact-check) reads as circular sourcing.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Unverified. Claim sourced to a single 2019 extortion email; no bodies found despite first-ever 2026 search of Zorro Ranch.
fact_check.notes: FBI did receive the 2019 email and took no action. NM authorities conducted first-ever search in March 2026 — no remains recovered as of available reporting.

importance.lens_rationale: 1M+ impressions on a categorical statement that two children were murdered and buried; conspiracy ecosystem amplification of unverified Epstein claims erodes information integrity around real, serious matters.
